limits: Controlled source observations only. The second fixture corrects the curse flag address to C0BF and gives the screen spell enough magic; initial selected-only results are not action activation proof.

The screen spell is active but no fan runs within the observation window, so those three cases do not prove full-pool fan behavior. Lantern/Bell are selected in a non-specific exterior context; their contextual effects are not claimed.

No net target byte change is observed in the30 eligible source cases, including real Axe swings, healing/potion/remedy and water-context thrown axe. No universal IY invariant or source/native whole-game equivalence follows.
